details: BlackRock, the world's largest asset manager, has submitted a comment letter to the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC), advocating for the expansion of eligible assets for tokenized reserves, pushing back on potential caps. This move signals a strong institutional interest in broadening the scope of tokenized real-world assets within the financial system.
title: BlackRock Urges OCC to Expand Tokenized Asset Eligibility

details: Analytics firm CryptoQuant suggests that Bitcoin's price surge in April was largely "speculative" due to weak spot demand. The firm has issued a warning about potential correction risks, advising investors to exercise caution.
title: CryptoQuant Warns Bitcoin's April Surge Was 'Speculative'

details: Coinbase has reportedly reached a deal regarding the Clarity Act's stablecoin yield provisions. This development could clear the path for the long-stalled Senate markup of the bill, potentially providing more regulatory clarity for stablecoins in the U.S.
title: Coinbase Reaches Deal on Clarity Act Stablecoin Yield

details: Mike Cagney, CEO of Figure Technology Solutions, believes blockchain will fundamentally reshape Wall Street's financial infrastructure. He stated that traditional intermediaries in markets like securitization, lending, and stock lending may be significantly replaced by on-chain processes, leading to lower costs and enhanced liquidity.
title: Figure CEO: Blockchain to Reconstruct Wall Street's "Financial Pipeline"

details: Hong Kong's recent stablecoin licenses have been quickly followed by the emergence of fake HSBC bank stablecoins, indicating a dangerous new wave of crypto scams. Investors are urged to be vigilant against such fraudulent offerings.
title: Fake HSBC Bank Stablecoins Emerge in New Crypto Scam Wave

details: The broader cryptocurrency market is showing a mild recovery, with Bitcoin rebounding from earlier lows. While Bitcoin has seen an increase, altcoins like Ethereum and Ripple are also aligning with this near-term recovery but are currently lacking significant momentum.
title: Bitcoin Shows Mild Recovery After Recent Correction
